## Description and Rationale

We are a group of individuals highly interested in pursuing aviation and data science, as well as discovering better method to combine the two subjects. Having done ADS-B reciever projects through opensky APIs before, we see this as a relevant new challenge!

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Netherlands
* Number of team members: 2
